# CrossPoint Reader 1.5.0-30

This release replaces full-library OPDS traversal with a purpose-built,
checksum-based Calibre library sync for Xteink X4 Pro.

## Added

- A compact server manifest containing every EPUB path, size, and SHA-256 checksum.
- Byte-for-byte EPUB downloads directly from the library sync service.
- Size and SHA-256 verification on the reader before an existing book is replaced.

## Improved

- Full-library comparison now uses one manifest request instead of traversing paginated OPDS feeds.
- Only new or content-changed books are downloaded; books removed from the server are removed from the synchronized collection.
- Reading progress is preserved when a synchronized EPUB is updated.

## Notes

- This release is for Xteink X4 Pro.
- The configured Calibre server credentials are also used to authenticate the sync manifest and book downloads.
